title: Dusty Dancing
html:
Quest Giver: Jerry the Dusty Dancer

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Search out the old dance instructor in Balzack's Burrow level 3.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerry the Dusty Dancer

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Dusty Dancer

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Search out the old dance instructor in Balzack's Burrow level 3.

Offer:

Someday I will be promoted to something better, maybe even to the Knight's dog walker, just you see. But for now, I was reading a piece of parchment and it was talking about how the King's Bishop had sent a dance instructor into Balzack's Burrow to teach the dancers inside the proper and official dance of the kingdom. Go see if you can find this instructor.

While you are talking to him, would you inquire if he has any dogs that need walking? I mean if I am going to have to stay employed as a dog walker I should probably try to drum up some more business.

Turn-in:

You put your soul in, you take your soul out, you put your soul in and you shake it all about. Do the Un-Holy Hokey Pokey, what a great dance. If only I was the one who would have come up with it.

Client level range: 55–100
